dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I recently lost a spear that looks similar to that used by the Millelith. I will be immensely grateful if anyone helps me find it!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you find the spear or have any information as to where it may be, please meet me near the shipyard."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "No matter if you are a Liyue resident or a traveler from afar, I would really appreciate your help."
